integrity: Proof uses an exact finite gap catalogue and parameter-uniform classification; independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: The constant local gap is proved for 2M+3 through 3M+4 only; maximality of that interval and exact total palindromic defect are unproved. Finite scripts corroborate, but do not prove, the all-parameter result.
title: A growing plateau of palindromic deficit in stretched Thue–Morse words
